newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi shares lower in subdued trading.
newsitem.headline: Saudi shares lower in subdued trading.

text.p: Shares on the Saudi stock market ended the week to Thursday lower in slow trading dominated by service sector shares, figures from the Riyadh-based Bakheet Financial Advisors (BFA) showed on Saturday.
The index ended the week 0.79 percent lower at 161.83 points from 163.12 points a week earlier.
Of the 58 companies traded, 22 rose, 30 fell and six were unchanged.
Services sector stocks accounted for 51 percent of volume which BFA put at about 5.2 million shares worth 831 million riyals ($222 million).
Saudi Industrial Export was the major gainer in the week adding 5.8 percent to 109 riyals from 103 riyals last week. Saudi Hotels gained 5.3 percent to 138 riylas from 131 a week earlier.
SCECO-Central lost 18 percent to 91 riyals from 111 the previous week and Yamama Cement ended 11.3 percent lower at 361 riyals from 407 last week.
